_why: 3.9: an enemy's Web leaves a patch at the player's spot (a foe_web terrain piece owned by the hedge-mage). At DC 15 the player fails the first save and is Restrained, and breaks free (Athletics 16) with no new save that turn; starting the next turn still in the patch, they make the Dexterity save again, fail, and are Restrained again. The hedge-mage keeps concentrating while its patch stands.
